credits.title: Amor Assombrado
credits.overview: A successful writer in a creative crisis lives with her characters and others who do not know what dimension they live in.

credits.title: What Ever Happened to Dulce Veiga?
credits.overview: In the 1980s, a journalist sets out to find the whereabouts of a famous singer/actress who disappeared decades earlier. During his search, he goes across several states in what ultimately becomes not only a search for a missing person but a journey of self-discovery.
